svg.title: Layer 2 — Robot runtime on Qualcomm QCS6490 / 9075
svg.desc: Full ROS2 Jazzy node graph on the Qualcomm RB3 Gen 2, from sensor drivers through VLA inference, skill dispatch, async motion planning, and realtime servo control to hardware actuators.

g.text: Qualcomm RB3 Gen 2 (QCS6490) — Ubuntu 26.04 · ROS2 Jazzy
